POSE 1: ISSUE - Floating leg, unnatural knee/ankle angles.
POSE 2: ISSUE - Disconnected lower leg, poor balance on one leg.
POSE 3: ISSUE - Missing lower leg, stiff posture.
POSE 4: OK - Dynamic stride, limbs connected, balanced.
POSE 5: ISSUE - Twisted spine, awkward leg crossing.
POSE 6: ISSUE - Broken neck/spine alignment, disjointed limbs.
